prompt: Jo’s cup sticker falls off. Jo thinks the drink’s colour gives away its identity. How should Jo proceed?
promptZh: Jo 的杯貼掉了。Jo 覺得可以靠顏色認出飲料。按規定該怎麼做？

options.text: Guess the drink from its colour and score it under that name.
options.zh: 依顏色猜出飲料，並用品名記分。
options.whyZh: 不能靠顏色辨認，也只能用杯貼代碼記分。

options.text: Return the cup to the preparation desk for a newly coded sample; leave the score sheet at the seat.
options.zh: 把杯子交回備料台，換一杯有代碼的樣品；評分表留在座位。
options.whyZh: 杯貼脫落時須由備料台依配置圖換杯，否則無法按指定代碼記分。

options.text: Take the score sheet to the preparation desk and ask to see the drink name.
options.zh: 把評分表帶到備料台，要求查看品名。
options.whyZh: 評分表留在座位；所有人完成評分前不公開品名。

options.text: Write “not tasted” and finish without requesting another cup.
options.zh: 標成「未試飲」並結束，不要求換樣品。
options.whyZh: 此情況是代碼掉落，規定要換一杯，不是因飲食限制跳過。

explanationZh: 杯貼脫落時須由備料台依配置圖換杯，否則無法按指定代碼記分。
evidence: The tasting team compares three drinks without seeing the brand names. Use only the two-letter codes printed on the cup stickers when recording scores. The product names remain in a sealed envelope until every panel member has finished scoring. | If a sticker comes off, do not try to identify the drink by colour or smell. Give the cup to the preparation desk and ask for a fresh sample. The desk uses the tray map to prepare a new coded cup. Keep your score sheet at your seat while waiting.

vocabulary.note: 以識別碼而非品牌名稱標示的樣品。
